title: Workload IR
description: Draft contract for workload descriptions referenced by the experiment manifest's workload_ir role (T004 / G4). Repo-level contract: lives outside Scale-up_Agent_Handoff/ per the handoff fence; promotion into the handoff schema set is an owner/ADR decision. Two dialects are recognized: an explicit event-DAG form (handoff example style: request arrivals, decode steps, collectives, KV transfers with depends_on edges) and a generator-parameter form (experiments/workloads/*.yaml: parameters for the W1/W2/W3/W5 deterministic generators). The dialects are disjoint by their identity keys (workload_id vs workload). Integer byte counts only (handoff determinism rules). schema_version changes on every public change to this contract. Version record: 2026-10-28 (T030) added w3_moe_dispatch_combine to the generator ladder; documents on the extended contract declare schema_version 1.0.0 (the first explicitly versioned generator-form documents). 2026-10-28 (T031) added w5_pd_kv_prefill_decode (PD/KV memory-semantic event generator) and made `layers` kind-conditional: required for the w1/w2/w3 kinds, forbidden for w5 (W5's positional structure is requests/chunks/steps, not transformer layers); documents on the further-extended contract declare schema_version 1.1.0.

schema_version.description: Version of this document contract; optional because the existing experiment inputs predate it.

eventDagForm.description: Handoff example style: explicit event DAG with portability declarations.

trace_kind.description: Synthetic by construction, or captured from a real serving system (trace ingestion is pending a human decision).

portability.description: Which timing/decision details are claims about reality vs portable structure.

type.description: Observed event inventory; extending this set requires a schema_version bump.

depends_on.description: Direct predecessor event ids; may be empty.

tokens.description: DecodeStep: tokens produced in this step.

message_bytes.description: Collective: payload M in integer bytes.

realized_algorithm.description: Collective: algorithm realizing the logical operation, e.g. ring.

generatorParamsForm.description: Repo generator style: deterministic parameters for the W1/W2/W3/W5 workload generators (essun.workload.w1/w2/w3/w5).

workload.description: Committed workload kinds (WORKLOAD_KIND in essun.workload); extending the ladder requires a schema_version bump. w3 (T030) issues all-to-all ops and w5 (T031) issues memory-semantic KV ops (kv_alloc/kv_write/kv_transfer/kv_visible/kv_read/kv_release); no registered backend executes either op class: W3/W5 manifests are rejected loudly by the capability gates and need L1/L2 to run.

steps.description: W1 only: number of decode steps.

chunks_per_layer.description: W2 only: activation chunks per layer.

allreduce_bytes.description: W1 only: free parameter (A-W1-SIZE), integer bytes.

chunk_bytes.description: W2 only: free parameter (A-W2-CHUNK), integer bytes.

experts_per_layer.description: W3 only: number of experts per MoE layer.

top_k.description: W3 only: experts routed per token (distinct; must be <= experts_per_layer).

tokens_per_rank.description: W3 only: activation tokens held per rank entering each layer.

token_bytes.description: W3 only: free parameter (A-W3-SIZE), integer bytes per token per expert visit, identical in dispatch and combine.

routing.description: W3 only: routing input mode (A-W3-ROUTE) — shares matrix with deterministic apportionment, or explicit routing table. Never learned or stochastic.

expert_shares.description: W3 only: per-layer integer skew matrix (layers x experts, A-W3-SHARES); the free-parameter routing-skew input.

expert_placement.description: W3 only: expert -> rank placement table (A-W3-PLACE); omitted means round-robin expert % tp_size.

routing_table.description: W3 only: explicit deterministic routing table (routing='table'): [layer][rank][token] -> top_k distinct expert ids (A-W3-ROUTE).

prefill_nodes.description: W5 only: number of prefill nodes P (A-W5-PLACE); ranks [0, P) prefill, [P, tp_size) decode; must leave at least one decode node.

requests.description: W5 only: number of served requests (placed round-robin q%P prefill, P+q%D decode).

chunks_per_request.description: W5 only: KV chunks per request (each chunk: alloc, write, transfer, visible lifecycle).

chunk_bytes.description: W5 only: free parameter (A-W5-SIZE), integer bytes per KV chunk, identical on write/transfer/read.

decode_steps.description: W5 only: uniform fixed decode steps per request (A-W5-STEP); each step reads every chunk once.

then.description: layers is ambiguous on a W5 document (W5's positional structure is requests/chunks/steps, not transformer layers) — rejected, matching the loader.
